productionEngineReference.note: The research layer is SEPARATE and does NOT use these production configs/decisions.

data.priceType: MID (OANDA price=M) — no bid/ask, so no candle-store spread
data.spread: NOT in candle store (mid only, no bid/ask)
data.timestamp: time = candle START (UTC, timestamptz); close = time + 15m; complete-only ingested

replayContract.timestampSemantics: OANDA time = candle START (UTC); close = time+15m; complete-only ingested
replayContract.eligibility: a candle is eligible at close T iff open + 15m <= T
replayContract.asOf: one synchronized 28-pair view drives every feature, cross-pair calc, chart and decision

costsAssumed: NONE in Stage 1 (no strategies). Spread/slippage MUST be modelled from an external source later — the candle store is mid-only.

existingReports.oldValidationHourlySample: docs/M15_VALIDATION.md is an every-4th-close HOURLY SAMPLE; its ~10-13 fills are NOT a full-cadence baseline and NOT a profitability basis

episodeDefinition: N/A in Stage 1 — no strategies created
researchInterface: research/m15/loader.js: syncAsOf(historiesByPair, evaluationCloseUtc) | replay(histories,{fromCloseMs,toCloseMs,onClose,warmupCandles,startAtCloseMs}) | integrityReport | loadAllPairsFromDb (SELECT-only, batched, chronological)
